g.text: What you'll be able to do
After this lecture and chapter 4, you can:
Explain what Boolean algebra is and where it is used.
Reason about Boolean functions with the algebraic laws.
Read and build a circuit that adds binary numbers.
Evaluate a formula in a Boolean model.
Test a propositional inference for countermodels.
Read chapter 4 first; exercise sheet 4 comes after the lecture.
